_readme: Method basis of each calculator, used to classify it. 'textbook' (default) = a definition, identity or standard textbook formula, so the maths is exact for its stated inputs. 'standard-method' = a method taken from a standard or practice whose constants or tables must be confirmed against the licensed edition. 'simplified' = a simplified model, rule of thumb or estimate; results are indicative and further engineering checks are required. These are the author's provisional judgements and are themselves open to the technical reviewer. Calculation author, exact references and next-review dates are NOT filled in here: they are entered in tools/review_records.json when a real review is done (see docs/VERIFICATION_REGISTER.md).

simplified.cable-derating: Temperature factor is a heat-balance approximation, not the tabulated standard factor
simplified.earth-grid-resistance: Laurent-Niemann form without the depth refinement
simplified.fault-current: Infinite source, terminal fault, cable impedance ignored (upper bound)
simplified.fault-types: Z2 = Z1, magnitude addition, bolted fault
simplified.fault-loop-impedance: Arithmetic addition, bolted fault, device operating current supplied by the user
simplified.breaker-size: Selection on current only; breaking capacity, trip curve and discrimination are not checked
simplified.parallel-cable-sets: Assumes equal sharing between identical cables
simplified.transformer-sizing: Selection from a standard-size list; harmonics, starting and ambient not modelled
simplified.generator-kva: Sizing estimate; starting and transient loads need a full study
simplified.motor-starting: Torque and current ratios assume no voltage sag
simplified.motor-start-dip: Arithmetic impedance addition, starting power factor ignored
simplified.conduit-fill: NEC-style fill convention, not a universal rule
simplified.agl-lamp-life-curve: Empirical life-versus-current relationship; manufacturer curve governs
simplified.pv-energy: Yield estimate from a performance ratio
simplified.pv-array-size: Sizing estimate from an energy need
simplified.ups-runtime: Runtime estimate; discharge-rate effects are simplified
simplified.battery-bank-size: Sizing estimate from simple derating factors
simplified.watts-to-lux: Estimate from assumed efficacy and geometry
simplified.lux-to-watts: Estimate from assumed efficacy and geometry
simplified.wind-power: Idealised turbine power with an assumed power coefficient
simplified.water-heater-kw: Heating estimate without losses unless entered
simplified.agl-lamp-failure-load: Open-secondary transformer treated as a fixed input power; the real value depends on the core design

standard_method.cable-sc-withstand: Adiabatic k values published in IEC 60364-4-43 / 60364-5-54; edition not revalidated
standard_method.cable-size-vd: Sizes for voltage drop only from the IEC 60228 size list; ampacity is a separate check
standard_method.rtd-pt100: Callendar-Van Dusen coefficients from the RTD standard
